# Machine

Turn one line naming a machine (a turbofan, a pinball machine, a coffee machine, a V8) into a photoreal, interactive 3D simulation in a single HTML file: it studies the real device, builds a solver that computes the actual numbers (move the throttle and the thrust, RPM and fuel flow are solved physics, not a canned animation), frames and lights the scene, runs a built-in critic pass, and can film a 20 to 30 second launch video of the result.
